# Ethereum Core Devs Meeting 41 Agenda
### Meeting Date/Time: Friday 06/29/18 at [14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/gmt-to-germany-berlin-united-kingdom-london-ny-new-york-city-ca-san-francisco-china-shanghai-japan-tokyo/2pm)
### Meeting Duration 1.5 hours
### [YouTube Live Stream Link](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HpCMguxraBA)
### [Livepeer Stream Link](http://crypto.livepeer.tv)

# Agenda

1. Testing
1. Client Updates
1. Research Updates
1. Constantinople hard fork timing and what to include (continuing conversation from last call).
  a. [EIP 145: Bitwise shifting instructions in EVM](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-145.md): pretty well-formed, but not 100% implemented or tested.
  b. [EIP 210: Blockhash refactoring](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/210).
  c. [EIP859: account abstraction](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/859).
  d. [EIP 1052: EXTCODEHASH Opcode](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1052).
  e. [EIP 1087: Net gas metering for SSTORE operations](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1087).
  f. [EIP 1014: Skinny CREATE2](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/1014).

**NOTE: Because of the conflict with ECDC we may skip Constantinople talk if there aren't enough devs to contribute to the discussion.**

Please provide comments to add or correct agenda topics.
